title: $p1$: Better Prompt Optimization with Fewer Prompts
abstract: arXiv:2604.08801v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Prompt optimization improves language models without updating their weights by searching for a better system prompt, but its effectiveness varies widely across tasks. We study what makes a task amenable to prompt optimization. We show that the reward variance across different system prompts can be decomposed into two components: variance among responses, which captures generation stochasticity, and variance among system prompts, which captures differences in system prompt quality. Prompt optimization succeeds when variance among system prompts is sufficiently large, but fails when variance among responses dominates the variance of the system prompts. Surprisingly, we further show that scaling to more user prompts can hurt optimization by reducing variance among system prompts, especially on heterogeneous datasets where different user prompts favor different system prompts. translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.08801v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：提示优化通过搜索更好的系统提示来改进语言模型，而无需更新其权重，但其效果在不同任务间差异很大。我们研究了什么使任务适合提示优化。我们表明，不同系统提示之间的奖励方差可以分解为两个部分：响应之间的方差（捕捉生成随机性）和系统提示之间的方差（捕捉系统提示质量的差异）。当系统提示之间的方差足够大时，提示优化成功，但当响应之间的方差主导系统提示的方差时，提示优化失败。令人惊讶的是，我们进一步表明，扩展到更多用户提示可能通过减少系统提示之间的方差而损害优化，尤其是在异构数据集上，其中不同用户提示偏好不同的系统提示。受此洞察的启发，我们提出了$p1$，一种简单的用户...
tldr: 本文发现提示优化的成败取决于系统提示间方差与响应间方差的相对大小，并指出增加用户提示可能降低系统提示间方差，从而提出$p1$方法以更少的提示实现更优的优化效果。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that prompt optimization success depends on the ratio of variance among system prompts to variance among responses, and shows that scaling user prompts can reduce system prompt variance, proposing $p1$ for better optimization with fewer prompts.
